text:
alex: Alert: elevated 5xx from eu-west-1 inference cluster, spike in queue length on dedicated pools. latency doubled :rotating_light:

deploy-bot: [ALERT] service=inference-hosted region=eu-west-1 error_rate=18% affected_pools=[dedicated-gpu-v2]

maria_sre: Looking. Is this infra-side (networking) or local GPU OOMs?

jon_mlinfra: Seeing CUDA OOM restarts on subset of nodes (n2-gpu-8) + nic-3 networking flaps causing pod restarts. Plan: shift traffic off eu-west-1 to us-east-1/us-west-2 via GLB weighted routing while we reprovision. Need ✅ to proceed.

cassie_ops: Agree. Pre-warm us-east pools before shifting heavy weight. Free GPUs in us-east: 28. Can we spin up +10 reserved nodes?

ryan_eng: Reminder: cross-region traffic increases egress cost. Estimate +$0.12/token for big batches. Also expect KV cache miss storm — prepare cache-warm.

jon_mlinfra: Proposed quick plan:
1) Update GLB routing policy: eu-west-1->10%, us-east-1->60%, us-west-2->30%
2) Enable autoscale in us-east (gpu-pool-east +10 nodes)
3) Warm prefix/KV caches with synthetic requests
4) Monitor 5xx and latency; rollback if 5xx > 5% over 2m

jon_mlinfra: curl example to update GLB:
```
curl -X POST "https://glb.internal/api/v1/routing" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $GLB_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"policy":"weighted","weights":{"eu-west-1":10,"us-east-1":60,"us-west-2":30}}'
```

maria_sre: Do it. I'll run the cache-warm job and watch traces :eyes:

infra-oncall: Executing route update now.

deploy-bot: [GLB] routing update accepted. new_weights={"eu-west-1":10,"us-east-1":60,"us-west-2":30}

cassie_ops: Scaling us-east: asg/gpu-pool-east desired_capacity += 10 — kicking off now.

jon_mlinfra: Cache-warm started: 2k prefix probes queued. Recommend throttling dedicated-only workloads to 50% concurrency for 10m to avoid warmup spikes.

alex: Initial telemetry: 5xx down to 7% after ~90s, avg latency in failing region back to baseline for routed requests in us-east. Keeping weights for 15m and monitoring :thumbsup:

ryan_eng: Please open a cost ticket for the egress bump and flag customers with region-residency needs.

maria_sre: Filed INC-2026-341 with graphs and trace links.

alex: Follow-ups for postmortem: a) migrate critical pods away from NIC profile nic-3, b) add GLB quick-shift runbook + one-click script, c) cost alert for cross-region egress > $5k/day. Will close incident if stable in 1h.

cassie_ops: I'll draft the runbook and attach scaling playbook.

jon_mlinfra: Adding note: consider automating cache-warm on GLB shifts to avoid immediate miss storms.

alex: Great. Thanks everyone — keep updates here if any regressions.
